name: Broghurt
source:
Broghurt follows Ron Chee, a shy guy who is told by his faculty advisor (and his mom) that he needs to go out and socialize more. He decides to go to a party at the "Theta Delta Epsilon" fraternity, to prove that he's not a recluse. This is where he gets his fateful first taste of "Broghurt"

You play as Ron, as he wakes up the next morning, unable to remember anything from the previous night. All that you know, is that you're missing your glasses, your phone, and your keys.

[From [url=https://mystery-zone-games.itch.io/broghurt]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Broghurt》讲述害羞的Ron Chee的故事。学院导师和母亲都劝他多外出社交。他决定去“Theta Delta Epsilon”兄弟会参加派对，以证明自己不是个独来独往的人。就在那儿，他第一次尝到了命中注定的“Broghurt”。

你将扮演Ron，在第二天早晨醒来，却完全不记得前一晚发生了什么。你只知道，眼镜、手机和钥匙都不见了。

[来源：[url=https://mystery-zone-games.itch.io/broghurt]Itch.io[/url]]
